newsitem.title: GERMANY: AVA says 1996 profits, sales rose.
newsitem.headline: AVA says 1996 profits, sales rose.

text.p: German retail group AVA Allgemeine Handelsgesellschaft der Verbraucher AG said on Friday turnover and profits rose last year and it expected further sales growth in 1997.
The company said sales rose last year to 9.1 billion marks from 8.6 billion, excluding sales from the company's Nanz unit.
Group net profits were significantly higher in 1996 than the 10.5 million marks earned in 1995, when the dividend was cancelled and profits channelled into reserves.
Turnover this year should rise to 9.3 billion, and, including other activities -- mainly at the Nanz deliveries unit -- is forecast at 10.4 billion marks.
